A good checker should catch roughly these categories and corrections. Some style fixes are subjective, so I’d keep them separate from strict grammar errors.

A few of these are intentionally style warnings rather than hard errors: revert back, collaborate together, each and every, at this point in time, and in my personal opinion, I think. For FluentTyper I'd show them differently from red grammar/spelling errors.
